parameters.jsCode:
const c = $input.item.json;
return {
  json: {
    // Preserve all fields so Split Out has airlineCodes downstream
    messageId: c.messageId,
    originalSubject: c.originalSubject,
    quoteNumber: c.quoteNumber,
    shipper: c.shipper,
    airlineCodes: c.airlineCodes,
    pod: c.pod,
    pol: c.pol,
    chargeableWeightKg: c.chargeableWeightKg,
    grossWeightKg: c.grossWeightKg,
    cargoType: c.cargoType,
    pieces: c.pieces,
    dimensions: c.dimensions,
    fallbackReason: c.fallbackReason,
    needsManualReview: c.needsManualReview,
    // Exact sheet column names for autoMapInputData
    DATE: $now.toFormat('yyyy-LL-dd'),
    'EMAIL SUBJECT': c.originalSubject || '',
    'QUOTE NUMBER': c.quoteNumber || '',
    'AGENT/CUSTOMER': c.shipper || '',
    AIRLINE: (c.airlineCodes || []).filter(a => a && a !== 'UNASSIGNED').join(', '),
    DEST: c.pod || '',
    'CW (KGS)': c.chargeableWeightKg != null ? String(c.chargeableWeightKg) : '',
    'SENT BY': '',
    STATUS: 'DRAFT',
    REMARK: c.fallbackReason || ''
  }
};
